proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_signal_type (directional-long family: UP_TRI + BULL_PROXY) = directional_long (94.3%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_signal_type (directional-long family: UP_TRI + BULL_PROXY) = directional_long; recommended action: Pause new UP_TRI and BULL_PROXY entries until directional-long share falls below 85% via natural Day-6 exits; if adding, prioritize DOWN_TRI or hedge new long adds with an index short (e.g., NIFTY futures short sized to ~10-15% of book notional) to reduce net directional-long exposure while Choppy×UP_TRI cohort remains unvalidated.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: A regime flip from Choppy to Bear, or a sharp broad-market gap-down, hits 94.3% of the book simultaneously with no offsetting shorts. Because the dominant Choppy×UP_TRI cohort is only Candidate-tier (n=373), there is no validated WR/edge evidence that these longs recover — drawdown would be correlated across Bank (12), CapGoods (8), and the FMCG/Chem/IT/Metal cluster with no diversification benefit.

evidence: Regime concentration 64.15% Choppy (below 0.80 threshold, but dominant)

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.recommended_action: Pause new UP_TRI and BULL_PROXY entries until directional-long share falls below 85% via natural Day-6 exits; if adding, prioritize DOWN_TRI or hedge new long adds with an index short (e.g., NIFTY futures short sized to ~10-15% of book notional) to reduce net directional-long exposure while Choppy×UP_TRI cohort remains unvalidated.
decision_metadata.tail_risk_scenario: A regime flip from Choppy to Bear, or a sharp broad-market gap-down, hits 94.3% of the book simultaneously with no offsetting shorts. Because the dominant Choppy×UP_TRI cohort is only Candidate-tier (n=373), there is no validated WR/edge evidence that these longs recover — drawdown would be correlated across Bank (12), CapGoods (8), and the FMCG/Chem/IT/Metal cluster with no diversification benefit.
decision_metadata.llm_rationale: No hard threshold is breached individually — regime concentration at 64.15% Choppy is below 0.80, top cell UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank at 15.09% is below 0.20, and UP_TRI at 42/53 = 79.2% is below 0.85. However, combining UP_TRI (42) with BULL_PROXY (8) yields 50/53 = 94.3% directional-long exposure, effectively a monoculture, and the matched Choppy×UP_TRI cohort remains Candidate-tier (n=373) — unvalidated edge. This extends a multi-week warn streak of directional-long exposure without cohort validation.
